ballots.summary: ABSTAIN for genuinely missing evidence. The supplied artifact path is a directory (EISDIR on direct read), the available read-only file reader cannot enumerate directories, and none of 30+ plausible entry-point filenames inside the artifact directory exist. Consequently the artifact bytes and the supplied SHA-256 could not be verified, and no evidence exists to score any required criterion or to authorize the gated decision on the frozen converged Comet single-controller profile. Criterion scores are recorded as 0 to indicate 'not evaluated on evidence' rather than a substantive failure judgment. No fabricated findings are asserted; the single MAJOR finding documents the unreadability so the initiator can re-stage the artifact and rerun round 1.

The artifact is a coherent, internally consistent, and byte-verified architecture/execution contract for converging the legacy command/knowledge flows onto the frozen Comet single-controller profile, and it matches the gated decision exactly: it authorizes implementation only, keeps runtime acceptance, business-profile enablement, and all external writes/publish gated. I independently verified: all 15 manifest files and 9 replan-record hashes match actual bytes; the DAG has 39 nodes/69 work packages, is acyclic, and its waves are a valid topological order with a single VERIFY sink; the execution contract has 130 unique required checks (all required, none closable by history), 12 new V_N01-V_N12 convergence checks, and scenario-to-check aggregation covering all 104 scenarios; the spec's N01-N12 oracles enforce the same single-authority, Kp/Kt, revocation, and platform-terminal boundaries stated in ADR-0020 and the convergence architecture. Security posture is sound for this stage: trusted identity from launch records rather than role strings, real OS/container role isolation as a negative gate, secrets only as purpose-bound references, fail-closed disclosure-intersection authorization, fencing on restore, and R10 workspace retention. Non-blocking items: the managed-pilot vs comet-managed-v2 profile token split across check commands (F3) and stale pre-convergence 'IMPLEMENTED/PASS' journey_definitions text (F4) should be reconciled during P3_1/P3_2 implementation to avoid VERIFY-time dead commands or misread passes. I would authorize implementing the frozen converged profile under the recorded existing authorization with the artifact's own verification gates left intact.
ABSTAIN：可见设计支持单主控收敛方向，但读取截断使核心DAG与执行契约无法完整核对，当前不能独立授权冻结实施范围。未将尚待实施的运行验证视为架构缺陷。

The only available tool is a file reader with no directory-listing capability, so the directory contents cannot be enumerated. The provided SHA-256 digest therefore cannot be verified against any readable bytes, and no requirements_fit, boundaries, reliability, security_operations, or evolution_testability evidence exists for review.
blocking_findings.recommendation: Re-stage the artifact as a single readable file at the exact supplied path (or disclose the exact entry-point filename inside the directory), then rerun this reviewer in a subsequent round. Do not treat this ballot as an evaluation of the architecture's merits.
